# Fairness mitigation experiment — per-age-group t_mod (not applied)

*Generated by `python -m ml.training.mitigation`. Thresholds fitted on cal-B, results on test.*

Each age group gets its own t_mod = largest threshold with recall >= 0.80 **within that group** on cal-B. t_high is unchanged. Flagged = moderate or high band.
